course_name_en: UE11 - L3SPI-OBM5ASTEC - Automation of Technological Systems
assessment_rules: For the main session, the continuous assessment (written and/or oral) has a coefficient of 1.5, the terminal written exam has a coefficient of 3, and the practical test has a coefficient of 1.5. For the resit session, there is a terminal written exam with a coefficient of 3. The marks from the continuous assessment (coefficient 1.5) and the practical test (coefficient 1.5) are carried over.
degree: Licence Sciences pour l'ingénieur, parcours Mécanique (UFR Sciences et Techniques)
